articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.snippet: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
articles.snippet: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

articles.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
articles.snippet: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.snippet: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

articles.title: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
articles.snippet: Both boards are now studying a tie-up that would put Grok, X, Starlink, orbital data centers, a chip megafactory and Optimus robots under one roof—and under one man's control.
